scope: Static review of logical component/pin/net source blocks, selected manufacturer pinouts, passive flex interface, FPGA pin constraints and exported native XML connectivity. Boolean proofs use actual XML net names. This is not an assembled-board or fabrication-release validation.

corrected_findings.issue: Logic supervisor RESET# and MCU RUN used different net names, so the promised hardware MCU reset was absent.
corrected_findings.resolution: U201.35, reset pullup and service RUN pad now use LOGIC_RESETn, joining U23.1 directly. Upstream PWR_FAILn remains GPIO31 interrupt, allowing held-rail cleanup.

corrected_findings.issue: U35 SN74LVC16T245DGGR lacked physical pin39. TI pin-functions ground table omits39, but its package drawing clearly identifies39 as GND.
corrected_findings.resolution: U35.39 added GND/power_in. All48 physical package pins now represented.

corrected_findings.issue: Changing BIOS banks before first bridge ARM or resetting them at early power-fail warning could change ROM while the CPU fetches it.
corrected_findings.resolution: Implemented HDL fixes the bank per FPGA configuration; factory bank0 matches external pulldowns. MCU reset, ATA reset and power-fail warning do not write the bank outputs. Nonzero-bank builds and runtime selection remain unqualified until CPU reset or RAM-only restart coordination exists.

checks.description: 365 unique reference designators across controller, frontend, power-bus and BIOS source blocks; native generator additionally adds two CN503 FPC connectors and nine ERC declarations. Manufactured probe pads are retained in the native circuit but excluded from purchased parts. Optional BIOS has complete 48-pin NOR mapping.
All100 U10 physical package pin functions match manufacturer MachXO2-2000 pinout CSV TQFP100 column; FPGA LPF locations map to the same scalar native schematic nets.
Flex J50/J51 expose exactly28 ATA signals:16 DD,3 DA,6 host-control and3 response signals. No BIOS extra-address or ROM-CE net is incorrectly claimed available on CN503.
16 raw ATA data nets meet U35 host B-port;16 BUS_DD nets meet FPGA on A-port. Nine host controls are input-only through U36/U37. Response values and ownership OEs are separate.

Exhaustive8192 combinations evaluated from actual gate pin/net connections: BUS_SAFE equals all9 permit terms; data/IRQ/DMARQ OE releases whenever any term fails; IORDY releases unless BUS_SAFE and low-request both true.

32 combinations of physical selector, program-arm, FPGA write-enable, ROM-CE and host write-strobe: NOR WE# low only when custom selected, physically armed, explicitly authorized and selected write cycle active.
16 combinations of power-loss warning/C5 request and storage-good/SD request match physical C5 cutoff AND and SD-isolation NAND.
SN74LVC16T245, LVC244 and AXC4T245 selected package pin numbers, channel direction, control rail and ground/supply functions checked against primary TI datasheets.
Optional BIOS x8 mapping follows A-1 on ATA_DD8, A0..A6 on DD9..DD15, A7..A9 on DA0..DA2, extraA10..A19 tap and physical A20/A21 bank bits. Original mask ROM has no writable connection.
Base BIOS population consists only of R409 recovery pulldown and R410 high strap. Optional population must omit R410 before installing the physical selector.

Sixteen Harwin contact components map one-for-one to actual C5 side pins1..14 and TP2/TP8. Each is one terminal across its two physical solder lands. Retention, force, height and assembly fixture remain unqualified.

FPGA configuration SDA/SCL have added 4.7 kOhm pullups to +3V3_LOGIC. TPS2116 two VOUT pads share +5V_HOLD, with pin7 passive alias preventing a false duplicate-output ERC claim. J40/J41 physical MP hold-down pads are grounded.

All 365 source components and two native CN503 sockets agree with integrated native pin contracts and exported XML component fields/terminals/nets/types/DNP. Nine ERC flags are omitted from XML; all 50 intended unused endpoints are isolated. Physical bare probe pads remain in XML despite being excluded from purchased BOM. Safety equations are evaluated from exported XML connectivity.

All 28 raw G1 signals have distinct bare probe pads joining their actual CN503 socket and named circuit endpoint. Eight added direction/enable/request probes and three ground returns agree with XML; existing BUS_SAFE/DATA_OEn pads are retained. Probe placement/stub/loading targets are not physical qualification.

intentional_external_or_unpopulated_node: CONSOLE_3V3 and raw ATA nets terminate through the separate flex J50/J51 interface, added by the native generator.
CONSOLE_5V controller power comes from dedicated J20 wire pads; flex5V baseline links remain DNP.
ROM_A10..ROM_A19, ROM_CEn and STOCK_CEn are optional J40 motherboard tap nodes. Stock CE pad and isolated leg must remain distinct.
SW40 is an offboard physical switch with no carrier footprint. J41 is its carrier FPC harness interface.
FPGA_CCLK, SPISI, SPISO, SDA and SCL are unused configuration capabilities; factory FPGA programming uses explicit JTAG service pads.
LINK data and strobes may be high-impedance while MCU/FPGA held reset. Firmware must establish idle strobes and directions before releasing FPGA_RESETn and asserting BRIDGE_ARM.
release_gates_open: Native ERC/DRC, routing, package-pad validation, Gerber inspection and optional variant placement remain separate checks.
Console continuity/polarity, 3.3V signal levels, host IORDY pullup and retained GD-ROM ownership must be measured.
Slow ramp/rail-order/power-fail waveforms and transceiver OE/turnaround timing require bench qualification; static Ioff/Boolean review does not establish transient behavior.
Bank0-only factory BIOS option still needs console-first-fetch versus FPGA/NOR reset timing capture. No nonzero-bank or warm-switch qualification claimed.
Storage durability and bounded flush do not follow from reserve capacitor population; firmware completion contract and interruption tests remain required.
C5 contact retention, BOOT/EN service contacts, FPC bend/actuator clearance and measured shield clearance require physical installation validation.
Optional reserve charge resistor pulse-overload and all MLCC DC-bias/temperature/aging derating remain procurement/bench release checks; no card-flush guarantee.
revision_note: Refreshed after the corrected J51 mapping and 39 manufactured debug pads. Reusable checker verifies 376 integrated references, 367 XML references, 365 onboard footprints, all native endpoints, 100 FPGA package functions and 56 LPF pin/net constraints; all 8240 functional Boolean combinations use exported native connectivity. All 39 debug probe mappings are verified from XML. No mechanical, probe loading, timing or assembler fixture release is claimed.
